title: http_callout
description: Custom logic in any language: the node describes the request to a service (callout-request.json) and acts on its answer (callout-response.json) (spec §9.4).

fail_open.description: When the service cannot be asked: true carries on as if it had said continue, false answers 500.

include_headers.description: Headers shown to the service. Empty means all except Authorization and Cookie.

include_body_bytes.description: How much of the request body to show the service.

secret.description: Signs each call: X-Apg-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac-sha256 of "<t>.<body>">.
